biggest_catch: The $400 is clawed back if you close the account within six months — you have to keep it open and in good standing to keep the money.
catches: The $400 bonus is clawed back if the account is closed within six months of opening.
Aggregate $4,000 in ACH direct deposits must be received within 120 days of account opening.
You must open checking, enroll in paperless statements, pay the $5 Member Ownership Share, and fund the $25 checking opening deposit.
New to Purdue Federal only — existing members are excluded; HSA and business accounts are excluded.
Age 18+; SSN required; the bonus is taxable interest.
Geography: Lake or Porter County, Indiana ZIP codes, or qualifying LaPorte County membership.

steps: Confirm you are new to Purdue Federal and live in a Lake or Porter County, Indiana ZIP code or have qualifying LaPorte County membership.
Open a new checking account — pay the $5 Member Ownership Share and fund the $25 checking opening deposit — and enroll in paperless statements.
Within 120 days of opening, receive $4,000 in aggregate ACH direct deposits into the account.
Keep the account open and in good standing for at least six months — the $400 is clawed back if you close earlier.
Receive the $400 bonus within ten business days after all conditions are met.
timing: Bonus paid within ten business days after all conditions are met.
